description: This file is an HTML webpage that includes embedded JavaScript code to demonstrate or implement a tabset interface with history management using the Isomorphic SmartClient framework. It defines dynamic forms and a tab set, handles page load events, and manages browser history for navigation.

classes.name: TabSet
classes.description: A tabbed interface widget that supports navigation history and multiple tabs with associated content

classes.name: DynamicForm
classes.description: A form widget used to create and manage form fields and user input

methods.name: restoreTabSetState
methods.description: Restores the tab set state based on browser history or URL

methods.name: historyCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when browser history changes, updates the tab selection accordingly
